notes.title: Drag Movement Improvements and Other Changes
notes.content:
1. Several updates have been applied, including improvements to drag movement.

2. (macOS) As mentioned in the notice a few days ago, the game no longer runs on macOS versions below 10.15. This change is an unavoidable consequence of the game’s development engine, Unity, whose latest version (Unity 6) requires macOS 11.0 or later as the minimum supported version. The Steam client also ended support for macOS 10.15 as of February 15, 2025. Please update your macOS to version 11.0 or higher to continue playing the game.

Thank you.

tags.feature: Several updates have been applied, including improvements to drag movement.

notes.title: Addition of Easy Listening BGMs, Option to Increase Max Zoom Level, and More
notes.content:
1. Easy Listening BGMs Added
 A lighter style of BGMs has been added to let users choose background music that matches their preferences. The original soundtrack and easy listening BGMs can now be selected in the settings.

2. Option to Increase Max Zoom Level Added
 An option to increase the zoom limit has been added for users who find the maximum zoom level is insufficient. This feature can be enabled in the settings to allow further zooming beyond the default level.

3. Minor Bugs Fixed
 Minor bugs on Steam Deck and similar devices have been fixed.
